subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the number of employees using different modes of transport to reach their workplace.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bda10dd5354c2b37111a38d555869accf40efc931d09378c2f457cd0e55baea.png] 

The number of employees who walked to work was approximately what percentage more than those who travelled by bus?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of people who walked to their working place = 55

Total number of people who take a bus to their working place = 35

Difference = 55 - 35

⇒ 20

Required % = (20/35) × 100

⇒ 57.14% ≈ 57%

**∴ Required percentage is 57%.**
